system.special:
Water Current: 50-foot cone, 30 feet wide at the base; no save for the shove, save vs. death ray or be stunned 1d6 rounds.

Surface Wave: 120 feet long and 60 feet wide; 2d6 hull damage to vessels.

XP by HD: 9*=1,600; 10*=1,750; 11*=1,900; 12*=2,125; 13*=2,300; 14*=2,500; 15*=2,700.
system.description: Sea giants are usually friendly creatures that live in the deepest ocean canyons. They can hold their breath for a full turn on land and can push water in a 50-foot cone, shoving victims 60 feet away and stunning them for 1d6 rounds.
